# GitHub Actions Status Badge Configuration

## Badges to Add to README.md

Add these badges to your README.md file to show the status of your CI/CD pipelines:

```markdown
<!-- CI/CD Status -->
[![CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml)
[![CodeQL Analysis](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/codeql.yml)
[![Dependency Review](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/dependency-review.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/policedbc/qwendbc/actions/workflows/dependency-review.yml)

<!-- Security -->
[![Dependabot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependabot-enabled-blue.svg?logo=dependabot)](https://dependabot.com)
[![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/security-policy-green.svg)](SECURITY.md)

<!-- Community -->
[![Contributor Covenant](https://img.shields.io/badge/Contributor%20Covenant-2.0-4baaaa.svg)](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
[![Contributions Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/contributions-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md)
```

## Branch Protection Rules

Configure these branch protection rules for your main/master branch:

1. **Require pull request reviews before merging**: Enabled (1-2 reviewers)
2. **Require status checks to pass before merging**: Enabled
   - Required status checks:
     - `test-backend`
     - `security-scan`
3. **Require branches to be up to date before merging**: Enabled
4. **Include administrators**: Enabled
5. **Allow force pushes**: Disabled
6. **Allow deletions**: Disabled
7. **Block merge commits**: Optional (prefer squash merges)

## Required GitHub Secrets

Set up these secrets in your repository settings (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions):

| Secret Name | Description | Required For |
|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Auto-generated by GitHub | All workflows |
| `PYPI_TOKEN` | PyPI API token for publishing | Release workflow (optional) |
| `DOCKER_USERNAME` | Docker Hub username | Docker publishing (optional) |
| `DOCKER_PASSWORD` | Docker Hub password/token | Docker publishing (optional) |

## Enabling Workflows

After pushing these files to your repository:

1. Go to **Settings → Actions → General**
2. Ensure "Allow all actions and reusable workflows" is selected
3. For Dependabot auto-merge, enable it in **Settings → Code security and analysis**
4. Enable CodeQL in **Security → Code scanning**

## Recommended Labels

Create these labels in your repository for better issue/PR management:

### Priority Labels
- `priority: critical` (Red)
- `priority: high` (Orange)
- `priority: medium` (Yellow)
- `priority: low` (Green)

### Type Labels
- `bug` (Red)
- `enhancement` (Blue)
- `documentation` (Purple)
- `security` (Red with white text)
- `dependencies` (Dependabot blue)

### Status Labels
- `triage` (Gray)
- `in progress` (Yellow)
- `review needed` (Orange)
- `blocked` (Red)
- `stale` (Light gray)

### Component Labels
- `backend` (Green)
- `frontend` (Blue)
- `ci/cd` (Purple)
- `docker` (Blue with white text)
- `tests` (Yellow)

## Dependabot Configuration Notes

The dependabot.yml is configured to:
- Check for Python dependency updates daily at 6 AM UTC
- Group minor and patch updates together
- Check GitHub Actions weekly on Mondays
- Check Docker images weekly
- Automatically create PRs with appropriate labels
